summary: The only remaining v69 mismatch is the menu-heading attribute for the “Dog or other canine” line in #vanquished at segment 0 step 266. C records inverse attribute on the class heading while JavaScript records no attribute; text, RNG, cursor, and input sequence otherwise match. C wintty.c:tty_putstr() stores each NHW_MENU line attribute with the text and process_text_window() reapplies it. JavaScript insight.js passes the attribute, but js/tty_menu.js discarded row metadata in ttyMenuTextLayout() and its recorder writer always painted attribute 0. Preserve the row metadata through layout and apply the source style when drawing each recorder cell.

source.branch: For NHW_MENU/NHW_TEXT rows, tty_putstr() stores attr+1 in the first data byte; process_text_window() decodes it and brackets line output with term_start_attr()/term_end_attr(). The v69 #vanquished path supplies a nonzero menu_headings attribute for class headers.
callers: insight.c:list_vanquished() passes iflags.menu_headings.attr for class headers when ask is false.
wintty.c:tty_display_nhwindow() dispatches the NHW_MENU display to process_text_window().
JavaScript path: insight.js:list_vanquished() -> tty_menu.js:displayTtyMenuTextWindow() -> ttyWindowTextData() -> writeRecorderTtyWindowLine().

evidence: The admitted v69 evaluation accepted at 99cc21c records this case at 287/288 screens, 3110/3110 RNG calls, and 288/288 cursors, with no error. Its recording SHA is 6d8b519a0d960208d28b5d44aee3cc8eae3518999682f19bc971008e5dbb64bd.

A fresh replay on 5f1593cdc2a4c0a5c1b0c4d07a20b98098beca17 reproduces the sole first mismatch at segment 0, step 266, key c: screen cell row 2 column 41 is D with C attr 1 and JS attr 0; RNG and cursor match at the boundary. Diagnostic log: /tmp/teleport-validation-1000/run-PQ2zln/stdout.log.

In upstream win/tty/wintty.c:2365-2417, tty_putstr() stores attr+1 with NHW_MENU/NHW_TEXT row contents. At win/tty/wintty.c:1771-1848, process_text_window() reads data[i][0]-1 and applies that attribute before writing the row.

In js/insight.js:2472-2477, list_vanquished() attaches the configured class-heading attribute. In js/tty_menu.js, ttyWindowTextData(..., false) currently strips source line objects and writeRecorderTtyWindowLine() writes every cell with attribute 0; this removes the style before display.
